messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired (PD-987654) - HIGH - service: model-catalog. Trigger: catalog default revision mismatch detected during auto-rollout. Impact: tokenization errors / 5xx responses reported. Link: https://pagerduty.com/incidents/PD-987654
ryan (oncall): Acked. Taking it. Quick context: auto-rollout job promoted revision 2.3.7 as default but tokenizer config for that revision wasn't loaded, causing runtime "invalid token id" failures.
sara (eng-runtime): I'm seeing spikes in 500s across streamers. Log snippet: ```ERROR runtime/codec.go: tokenizer map missing token id 255 for model: llm-x-2.3.7```
mike (eng-platform): Noted. Initiating immediate rollback of catalog default to 2.3.6. Command I'm running: `redwood-catalog set-default --model llm-x --revision 2.3.6 --reason "emergency rollback - tokenizer mismatch"`
ryan (oncall): Pager acknowledged by ryan. Escalation timer set to 15m if no progress. Adding runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/catalog-rollbacks
dana (support): We've got 3 customer tickets flagged as high-priority: AcmeCorp, Shoply, FinRidge - they report truncated or garbled outputs. SEs already looped in. Preparing status update for status.redwood.ai
sara (eng-runtime): Reached serving nodes — hitting same error before rollback: ```invalid token id 0xff mapping failed -> generation aborted``` . After Mike's rollback command, I'm purging KV/prefix cache on serving nodes: `curl -s -XPOST http://serving-node-*/cache/purge`
mike (eng-platform): Cache purge started. Also blocking rollout job in orchestration: `k apply -f rollout/hold-llm-x.yaml` to stop auto-promote.
incident-bot: PagerDuty note: PD-987654 acknowledged by ryan. Automatic escalation cancelled.
sara (eng-runtime): Cache purge complete on 4/4 nodes. Observability shows token error rate dropped to 0. Errors replaced by normal token maps. Grafana shortlink: https://grafana/redwood/d/llm-x/token-errors
mike (eng-platform): Starting canary traffic to 2.3.6 default. Monitoring latency/errors.
dana (support): Notified customers via private incident updates. Message: "We're rolling back a recent catalog default; you may have seen garbled outputs. We're monitoring and will update when fixed."
ryan (oncall): After rollback + cache purge, 5xx rate returned to baseline. Confirming mitigation effective. Root cause looks like auto-rollout job didn't include tokenizer metadata bundle for 2.3.7.
sara (eng-runtime): Agree. Will run a tokenizer sanity check as postmortem action: ensure tokenizer loading passes smoke test before marking catalog revision as default.
mike (eng-platform): Filed follow-up ticket: INF-4212 - add pre-promote hook to verify tokenizer/vocab presence and run a quick sample generation.
dana (support): Keeping customers updated; SEs will validate outputs for affected accounts.
ryan (oncall): Handoff: I need to step out at 14:00 PST. Handover to sara for continued monitoring. Sara, please ack if you can take next watch.
sara (eng-runtime): Ack — I'll take next watch for 1 hour and then hand to oncall rotation if needed.
ryan (oncall): Declaring incident mitigated for now. Will open full incident report later with timeline and remediation items. :white_check_mark:
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-987654 status changed to "Resolved" by ryan.
ryan (oncall): Follow-up action items: 1) block auto-promote until INF-4212 is done; 2) add catalog preflight tokenizer check; 3) run retro with infra and runtime teams.
sara (eng-runtime): Copy. I'll keep an eye on logs for next 2 hours and report anything anomalous.
__note: This thread is a synthetic realistic Slack thread for dataset generation. No real PII or actual links were used.
